title: One Word, Two Meanings
description: Explore two meanings of the familiar words duck, bat, bark, and wave through pictures, model sentences, listening, speaking, and drawing.
learningFocus: Use sentence context and familiar experiences to distinguish between two meanings of the same word.
adultGuidance: Read the model sentences aloud, then invite your child to explain each meaning and respond orally in their own words; record their exact words, and offer drawing help as needed. For Page 3, the listening answers are: 1 duck—bend down; 2 bat—the animal; 3 bark—tree covering.

seo.title: Multiple Meaning Words Worksheets | Learning Made Simple
seo.description: Four free printable Kindergarten vocabulary activities using pictures and sentence context to explore two meanings of duck, bat, bark, and wave.
